page.meta_title: Hadoken (Street Fighter) — Item, lore & connections | Ton-o-Lore
page.meta_description: The Hadoken is the Ansatsuken projectile Ryu and Ken throw — a ki wave that became Street Fighter's most copied special move. Related pages: Ryu, Ken Masters.
page.content:
The ki fireball that made Ryu readable worldwide.

How Hadoken connects

  • Character: Ryu — Ryu's Hadoken is the signature Ansatsuken fireball.
  • Character: Ken Masters — Ken throws the same Hadoken his master taught Ryu.

What is Hadoken?

The Hadoken is the Ansatsuken projectile Ryu and Ken throw — a ki wave that became Street Fighter's most copied special move.

Key threads lead to Ryu and Ken Masters.
